 Follow GTA 6 Mandy Actor Officially Reveals Her Identity in Video After Character Goes Viral
 Nitish Singh Thu, November 19, 2026 at 11:33 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Rockstar Games The launch of GTA 6 has had everyone talking, but one supporting character has unexpectedly stolen the spotlight. Mandy , an NPC who appears early in the game, has become a major talking point among fans online.
 The mystery surrounding the character's voice and performance has now been cleared up, with the actor officially revealing her identity. Lexie Shoaibi confirmed in an Instagram post that she plays Mandy in Rockstar Games ' latest title.
 "I can now share with you guys a secret. I am in GTA 6. I play Mandy. I do her voice-over and her motion capture. And she's a lot of fun. So if you've played the game, let me know if you find me," Shoaibi said.
 Mandy has quickly become one of the game's most discussed supporting characters following her brief appearance during the opening chapter. Players encounter her when Jason Duval visits her home to collect rent on behalf of his landlord, Brian. However, Mandy refuses to pay until Jason helps fix a plumbing problem at her house.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Her flirtatious interaction with Jason has fueled conversations across social media, with some players joking about the possibility of pursuing Mandy instead of Lucia Caminos, one of the game's central characters.
 Players have been paying close attention to Mandy's role in GTA 6
 Mandy's popularity has emerged despite Rockstar not featuring her in any of the game's trailers or promotional material. Her introduction during the Pipework mission has instead turned her into an unexpected viral character.
 Players have been sharing screenshots, discussing her appearance, and joking about how quickly she has attracted attention ever since. However, the game's relationship features remain centered on Jason and Lucia, whose chemistry and rapport play a central role in the story.
 Mandy's growing popularity has also prompted players to look up the actor behind the character. Shoaibi's announcement has now confirmed her involvement, revealing that she handled both the voice acting and motion capture performances that brought Mandy to life.
